verdict.rationale: telli documents pieces of this flow. The REST API can schedule calls and import SIP-trunk phone numbers, and the official MCP server exposes Charlie, which the docs say can "build and refine agents." Agent creation is only reachable indirectly through the MCP assistant, and the evidence never shows a programmatic way to attach a number to an agent or a documented end-to-end headless flow. The API key itself must also be obtained from the app's Settings > Developer page. Missing for 10: a documented create-agent API/CLI endpoint, a programmatic number-to-agent assignment, an end-to-end provisioning walkthrough, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window.
Imports a phone number from your own SIP trunk provider.
The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.
Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
